assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only mushoku-tensei:ruijerd@light-novel#character-model, the canonical Ruijerd bounded reconstruction model (generation V1, revision 1.2) at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the locked Japanese light novels V01-V10, with direct Ruijerd grounds in V03-V06 and V10. The model routes its observations to an evidence index, shared state ledger sections, per-volume deep readings and checkpoint syntheses, none of which is curated on this subject or used as evidence here. The project's current-state entrypoint was read for method and gate state only; it records that Ruijerd 1.2 retains its earlier ceiling after the V11-V15 review. His reported war history is his testimony, not verified history. No web novel, later light-novel volume, adaptation, performed voice, reception or remembered franchise biography is in scope.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The model's eight selectors MT-JM-ST01 to ST08: V03 rescue, disclosed history and initial feared protector (ST01) and urban work, agreed restraint, guild scapegoating and renewed escort (ST02); V04 port, captives and village (ST03); V05 reunion mediation, an independent old friendship and passage (ST04); V06 practical care, hostage rescue, warrior recognition and defeat (ST05) and the received curse report, hope and farewell (ST06); and V10 the East Port rescue, listening and escort undertaking, revealed retrospectively rather than new (ST07), and the completed northern escort, reunion and resumed search (ST08). No selector covers V07-V09, nothing after V10 is established, his own search after the farewells is unobserved, and no earlier state acquires later knowledge.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model gives six conditional rules (MT-JM-001 to 006): decisive intervention when children are threatened, with protective duty outranking convenience and reputation; reclassifying a dependent as a warrior and expecting self-sufficiency while still giving care; embodied practical instruction calibrated by feedback; negotiated restraint and changed method when a trusted companion names a cost; reputation and reciprocity yielding to protecting particular people; and brief direct answers in which silence does not prove indifference. Each has a countercase and a possible falsifier, and the model explains him through changing classifications of child, warrior and wrongdoer rather than a fixed moral authority. B is not supported because rule 002's mechanism is rated moderate, the war history behind his duties is testimony, rule 003 has no newly witnessed V10 teaching and calibration is retrospective; falsifiable rules with countercases exceed a descriptive profile, so D is not supported.

Eight selectors run from V03 to V10 with per-state knowledge limits: the war account as testimony with survivors' fate unknown (ST01), motives of Rudeus he miscredits and flood preparation he never learns (ST02), a correction about the gift coexisting with excessive warrior expectations (ST03), private histories he does not receive (ST04), the dream source unknown until later inquiry (ST05), the curse report known as attributed rather than established (ST06) and the V10 escort revealed retrospectively, with his son's history and inferred training kept apart (ST07). The model also tracks narrow change: care alongside respect strengthens in V06, and protective force stops after de-escalation in V10. B is not supported because the selectors are one-line cells citing ledger sections, no state covers V07-V09 and the entrypoint keeps the model at its V10 ceiling; a sequence with explicit knowledge limits exceeds an undifferentiated profile, so D is not supported.

Rule 006 and its extensions describe his written speech only in prose: brief, direct answers, concrete practical judgments, understated pleasure or disapproval, explicit equal footing and a concise farewell (V03:018-020, V04:005/019/022, V05:013-016, V06:019-020) and terse acknowledgment of limited understanding (V10:026/031-032), with the limits that bluntness coexists with tact and uncertainty and that no hidden monologue or actor timbre is supplied. It quotes no wording or self-reference. Prose-only register description does not support D; the register is affirmatively characterized, so NOT_ASSESSED would ignore it.

One paragraph lists ordinary evidence: food and drink habits, weapon and stance appraisal, repeated training, travel work, visiting an old acquaintance and pleasure when a father and son reconcile, without content for any habit. Training is modeled by rule 003, but other ordinary behavior has no rule. C is not supported because the domestic and leisure material is listed rather than modeled; listed items plus modeled training exceed a single mention, so E is not supported.

The model differentiates recipients: Rudeus as protected companion and increasingly respected warrior whose needs the warrior status can eclipse, and whose motives Ruijerd can misread; Eris as a capable learner whose methods fit her and a child whose retaliation sometimes needs restraint (V03:005/020, V04:018/022, V06:014/020); Norn as a dependent whose position he admits he cannot fully know (V10:024/032); the Gash friendship as reciprocal and joyful despite limited rank knowledge (V05:014/021-022); beastfolk, old beneficiaries and feared strangers as non-interchangeable; and a tense old acquaintance at the V10 reunion that stays unexplained (V10:025). B is not supported because the cells are compressed, his reading of Rudeus's face is repeatedly corrected and the V10 unease is filtered through Rudeus; differentiated responses across several attested recipients exceed a single relational sketch, so D is not supported.

The model states that his self-concept is better supported through duties, testimony and choices than through extensive private narration. Located inner material is limited: despair and then hope at the curse report (V06:019), tears at the farewell (V06:019-020) and the V10 extra, which broadens direct access to reflection on his son and admitted limits of his understanding of Norn (V10:032) without authenticating remembered explanations. C is not supported because private narration is sparse and V10 is the only extended direct access; represented feeling and reflection across two volumes exceed a single attributed motive, so E is not supported.

Rules 001 and 004 govern conflict with countercases: killing classified wrongdoers beside agreed restraint and nonlethal practice (V03:002/004/011, V04:009-015), intervention despite an overwhelming opponent and defeat (V06:010/016), force against Eris during restraint whose necessity the model does not presume, and the V10 rescue in which he threatens an aggressor, releases him after apology and changes plan when the child refuses to return (V10:031). Rule 005 adds accepting disguise or personal blame when reputation conflicts with protection. B is not supported because the categories that license his force remain contestable, the Eris restraint encounter is incompletely narrated and calibration is retrospective; rule-level conflict treatment with countercases exceeds located disputes alone, so D is not supported.

The model locates morally weighted positions: protective duty outranking convenience and reputation, accepting personal blame, insisting that actual aid warrants equal recognition and refusing submissive thanks (V06:020), the reparative aspiration for the Superd and a changed view of smuggling (V04). It explicitly refuses to make him the novel's infallible moral referee and leaves his categories of wrongdoer contestable. C is not supported because these are positions and acts rather than rendered weighing; repeated located positions across four volumes exceed a single mention, so E is not supported.

The model records understated pleasure, a joyful old friendship and pleasure at a father and son reconciling, but no joking, teasing or play. Absence of evidence establishes neither a humorless disposition nor a capacity for humor.

One curated item: a compact model (revision 1.2) covering V03-V06 and V10 through six rules, eight selectors and eleven retrospective checks, with observations routed to an evidence index, shared ledger sections, deep readings and checkpoint syntheses that are not curated on his row. The model declares itself BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL with no clean holdout, names universal moral judgment, political forecasting, complete historical reconstruction, exact hidden feelings and performed speech as INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, and the entrypoint keeps it at its V10 ceiling after the V11-V15 review, so C is not supported; systematic coverage of the volumes in which he is a direct subject exceeds limited local evidence, so E is not supported.

The model locates affirmative limits and countercases: care withheld when warrior status eclipses need, force against Eris during restraint, misread motives of Rudeus and a first-glance flat expression later corrected to reluctance (MT-JM-V05), teaching that fits Eris and not Rudeus (MT-JM-V03), a high-status letter that fails at customs (MT-JM-V04), defeat by a superior opponent (V06:016), despair before qualified information (V06:019), and protective force that stops after de-escalation rather than always killing (V10:031). Each limit is a cell or clause and calibration is retrospective with disclosed prior familiarity, so B is not supported; located failures and countercases across five volumes exceed bare gap statements, so D is not supported.

Each selector is bound to a volume and a knowledge state: the war account and curse report stay attributed, flood preparation and private histories are withheld, the dream source is unknown until later inquiry, and the V10 East Port material is REVEALED_NOT_NEW, with his own son history and guessed training separated. B is not supported because the selectors are one-line labels citing ledger sections, no age or elapsed time is computed and V07-V09 have no state; D is not supported because knowledge is bounded per state rather than given as a loose period.

scenario_readiness.note: The model characterizes his register only in prose, quotes no wording and excludes invented hidden monologue and actor timbre. CONDITIONAL would generate speech from a prose register description; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the characterized register.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Any single named selector MT-JM-ST01 to ST08 in V03-V06 or V10, with that state's knowledge only; no state for V01-V02 or V07-V09, nothing after V10 and no verified version of his war history.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Only attested recipients in their state-specific relation: Rudeus as protected companion and recognized warrior, Eris as learner and child, Norn as escorted dependent, the Gash friend, beastfolk and old beneficiaries, captives and feared strangers, and the tense old acquaintance at the V10 reunion.
setting_constraints: The demon-continent travel, port, village, reunion, V06 and V10 escort settings of the Japanese light novels
His approval is not proof of another's motive, warrior recognition is not adult invulnerability and opponents are not proven villains by his classification
No political forecasting, institutional strategy or complete Superd history
Near-analog situations only; materially novel contexts end in abstention

scenario_readiness.note: The model permits D0 represented behavior and only D1 near-analog extension in named protection, training, familiar-party negotiation and written-directness contexts, keeps all admitted domains BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL, requires abstention in unsupported contexts and names universal moral judgment, political forecasting, complete historical reconstruction and exact hidden feelings as insufficient evidence; calibration is retrospective. CONDITIONAL would extend a near-analog license to materially novel contexts the model declines; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore its explicit application bounds.

Ordinary material beyond training is listed in one paragraph (food and drink habits, weapon appraisal, travel work, visiting an old acquaintance, pleasure at a reconciliation) without content or rule. CONDITIONAL would build ordinary social behavior from a list; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the listed material and the reciprocal friendship the model locates.

The evidence locates protective, reciprocal and reparative positions with reasons but no rendered weighing between competing goods, and the model refuses to treat him as a moral referee. CONDITIONAL would supply deliberation the model does not show; NOT_ASSESSED would ignore the located positions.
No romantic relationship of his is in evidence; his reflection on a son (V10:032) is not romance. Absence of evidence establishes neither readiness nor incapacity.

conditions: Only protective escort, rescue and embodied combat instruction in attested Japanese light-novel settings, as near analogs.
Learner and body fit matter: no universal pedagogy, and methods that suit Eris are not assumed to suit others.
Force rests on his classifications, which remain contestable; restraint and nonlethal stopping stay possible, and superior opponents can defeat him.
No academic, political or institutional expertise; the selected state's knowledge only; output is behavior described in prose and no quoted speech is generated as canonical.
scenario_readiness.note: The model names protective action and practical training among its BOUNDED_PROVISIONAL domains, and rules 001, 003 and 005 locate them: protective escort and rescue across V03-V06 and V10 (V03:002/004/011, V04:009-015, V06:010/016, V10:031/034), embodied sword instruction calibrated by feedback (V03:005/020, V04:003-004/018/022, V05:018-019, V06:014/020/024) and unpaid escort work that ends when he resumes his own search (V10:024/026/034). Readiness is conditional because his teaching fits some learners and not others, his force rests on contestable classifications, he can be defeated and calibration is retrospective. READY would treat compressed rule cells as a procedure; NOT_READY would deny the escort and instruction work the model locates in five volumes.

known_limits.statement: He is not the novel's infallible moral judge; his classifications of child, warrior and wrongdoer are contestable, and his approval does not prove another's motive.

Recognizing someone as a warrior can lead him to expect self-sufficiency and supply less care than needed; recognition does not mean adult invulnerability, and care remains possible alongside respect.
He kills classified wrongdoers but also accepts agreed restraint and stops force after de-escalation; outputs must not require killing or reduce him to indiscriminate violence.
His account of the Superd war and the curse report are attributed testimony, not verified history or established cosmology.
He miscredits some of Rudeus's motives and capacity, and narration's first reading of his flat face is corrected to reluctance; silence does not prove indifference or grievance.
His embodied instruction fits Eris better than Rudeus; it is not universal pedagogy or academic expertise.
Aid and reciprocity do not compel permanent service; he insists on equal recognition, accepts a gift and leaves for his own search.
A genuine friendship and a high-status letter do not make him an institutional or political strategist; the letter fails at customs.
All eleven checks are retrospective fits with disclosed prior franchise familiarity, not clean holdouts or registered predictions, and no domain is DOMAIN_READY.

The evidence index, shared ledger sections, deep readings and checkpoint syntheses to which the model routes its observations are not curated on this subject, so its locators were not rechecked here and no independent reconstruction test is in the evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.

Exact hidden feelings, political forecasting, complete Superd history, the V10 reunion unease and ordinary habits beyond the listed items are not established; this is a gap, not evidence of incapacity.
No wording, self-reference or acoustic performance is in evidence; register is described only in prose.
Direct grounds cover V03-V06 and V10 only; no state covers V07-V09, the entrypoint keeps the model at its V10 ceiling after the V11-V15 review, and nothing after V10 is assessed.
